# betterado_feature_flag (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "MyProject"
}

resource "betterado_feature_flag" "example" {
  feature_id  = "ms.vss-work.agile"
  scope_name  = "project"
  scope_value = data.betterado_project.example.id
  state       = "enabled"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_id` (String) The full contribution id of the feature (e.g. "ms.vss-work.agile").
- `scope_name` (String) The setting scope name (e.g. "project", "host").
- `scope_value` (String) The scope value (project ID for project-scope; empty string for host-scope).
- `state` (String) The desired feature state. Must be "enabled" or "disabled".

### Optional

- `reason` (String) Reason for the feature state.

### Read-Only

- `overridden` (Boolean) Whether the feature state has been set by an override rule.
